title: data.json
description: Schema for the site content consumed by generate.py. Fields get added here as generation logic lands, in lockstep with docs/guides/data-json.md.

quotes.description: One header quote per top-level section, keyed by the page's current_page. Project pages use the projects quote. See docs/arch/0028.

home.description: Quote shown in the header of the home page.

projects.description: Quote shown in the header of the projects index and every project page.

education.description: Optional quote shown in the header of the education page. Omitted if unset (docs/arch/0035).

experience.description: Optional quote shown in the header of the experience page. Omitted if unset (docs/arch/0035).

profile.description: Home page content: who the site belongs to.

name.description: Full name shown in the page header.

role.description: Short headline under the name, e.g. 'Software Engineer'.

tagline.description: One-line current role/status shown under the role.

picture.description: Path to a photo under assets/.

welcome.description: Short welcome blurb shown at the top of the page.

phone.description: Optional phone number shown in the Contact section, e.g. '(555) 555-5555'. Omit to hide it.

last_updated.description: Display string shown in the 'last updated' sidebar, e.g. 'October 2026'.

skills.description: Skills table rows, grouped by category.

logo.description: Path to a logo image under assets/.

links.description: Site-wide links: GitHub, LinkedIn, resume, etc.

url.description: External URL, or a path under assets/download/ for downloadable files.

project_name.description: URL-safe slug. Doubles as the dist/projects/<project_name>/ directory name, see docs/arch/0010.

title.description: Human-readable project name shown on the page.

image.description: Path to the main screenshot under assets/. Shown as the large preview on the project page and as the thumbnail on the projects index.

image_caption.description: Optional caption under the main preview on the project page. Defaults to '<title> preview'.

gallery.description: Optional extra screenshots, shown as a thumbnail row at the bottom of the project page. Each opens full size when clicked.

image.description: Path to an image under assets/.

caption.description: Optional caption shown under the enlarged image.

featured.description: Whether this project appears in the home page's Featured Projects section. Optional, defaults to not featured.

highlights.description: Optional short bullet points (awards, results, standout features) shown in a Highlights section on the project page.

facts.description: Optional label/value pairs (e.g. Year, Role, Team size, Status) shown in a Project Facts box in the project page's sidebar.

logo.description: Path to a logo image under assets/.

layer.description: Optional part of the stack this technology covers, e.g. 'Frontend'. Adds a Layer column to the project page's technologies table.

purpose.description: Optional one-line note on what this technology does in the project. Adds a Purpose column to the project page's technologies table.

featured.description: Optional. Featured technologies show as a large logo grid at the top of the project page's Technologies section; the rest go in a table (or smaller grid) underneath. Defaults to not featured.

links.description: Any number of links shown as buttons under the project title. Use type 'github' (or 'source' for other code hosts) for a 'view source' link; leave it out if the code isn't public.

url.description: External URL, or a path under assets/download/ for downloadable files.

education.description: Optional schools shown on the education page, most recent first. If left out, the page shows a short placeholder. See docs/arch/0036.

school.description: School name, shown as the section title.

subtitle.description: Optional one-line summary under the degree, e.g. majors and minor.

summary.description: Optional overview paragraph(s). Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

image.description: Optional photo under assets/, shown beside the overview.

gallery.description: Optional extra screenshots, shown as a thumbnail row at the bottom of the project page. Each opens full size when clicked.

image.description: Path to an image under assets/.

caption.description: Optional caption shown under the enlarged image.

facts.description: Optional label/value pairs (e.g. Year, Role, Team size, Status) shown in a Project Facts box in the project page's sidebar.

highlights.description: Optional honors and achievements, shown as a starred list.

links.description: Optional buttons under the school name, e.g. a transcript download.

url.description: External URL, or a path under assets/download/ for downloadable files.

terms.description: Optional transcript, one entry per term, in the order to show them.

gpa.description: Optional term GPA on a 4.0 scale. Terms with a GPA appear in the term GPA chart.

topic.description: Optional topic for variable-topic courses (seminars, research).

projects.description: Optional project_name slugs from projects[] that came out of this course; linked from the course and the Course Projects box.

experience.description: Optional content for the experience page: jobs, hackathons and other events, and certifications. If left out, the page shows a short placeholder. See docs/arch/0037.

summary.description: Optional overview paragraph(s). Separate paragraphs with a blank line.

links.description: Optional buttons in the page's hero, e.g. a resume download or LinkedIn.

url.description: External URL, or a path under assets/download/ for downloadable files.

positions.description: Optional jobs, most recent first. A first entry with no end date is shown in the hero as the current role.

start.description: Start month as YYYY-MM. Drives the displayed dates, the duration, and the timeline chart.

end.description: Optional end month as YYYY-MM. Leave it out for a current job; it shows as 'Present'.

highlights.description: Optional accomplishments, shown as a starred list.

technologies.description: Optional technologies used in the role. Shown as chips on the job and gathered into the page's Toolbox.

logo.description: Optional path to a logo image under assets/.

projects.description: Optional project_name slugs from projects[] that came out of this job; linked from the job.

events.description: Optional hackathons, competitions, or conferences, most recent first.

host.description: Optional host organization, e.g. a university.

date.description: Start date as YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Places the event on the timeline chart.

dates.description: Optional display string, e.g. 'September 28–29, 2024'. Defaults to the month and year of date.

role.description: Optional part you played, e.g. 'Frontend developer'.

awards.description: Optional awards won. Award-winning events get a star on the timeline.

project.description: Optional project_name slug from projects[] built at the event. Its image and a link to its page are shown on the event card.

image.description: Optional path to an event image under assets/, e.g. its logo. Shown on the card when there's no linked project. See docs/arch/0038.

date.description: Month earned as YYYY-MM. Places the certification on the timeline chart.

logo.description: Optional path to an issuer logo under assets/.
